items.claim: The Bank of Korea raised its Base Rate by 25 basis points to 3.25% on November 26, 2026, citing stronger growth, above-target inflation and financial stability risks.
The KOSPI rose 4.34% to close at 4,915.68 on November 27, 2026, as foreign investors bought a net 1.13 trillion won of local shares.
South Korea's chip exports nearly quadrupled from a year earlier to $38.5 billion in November 1-20, 2026, a record for the 20-day period, according to Korea Customs Service data.
